notes.title: Moving Release Forward
notes.content:
I was originally planning to release Turret Baffler in time for Halloween, but that might be my chronic procrastination at work. So, I'm moving it forward to the end of May.

[h1]Current state of things[/h1]
The game currently has 7 levels, plus the tutorial, and is undergoing beta testing. I was planning to add another three, but I don't see why I can't add them [i]after[/i] release.

[h1]What I have to add after release[/h1]
Obviously, bug fixes will come first. However, I'm going to add those three levels:
[list]
[*] Train yard - lowering a bridge to allow some help in.
[*] Generators - turning off some generators to hinder defences elsewhere.
[*] Evac - get out of the zone (again).
[/list]

The only significant mechanic I'm considering adding is a time limit - or rather, after 5 minutes or whenever guards WILL start spawning regardless of how many alerts you've had. This will provide some extra tension, forcing you to weigh stealth vs speed.

notes.title: 0.5-Beta
notes.content:
[h1]Performance fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Lowered physics tick rate from 60 to 30.
[*] Lowered some texture sizes.
[*] Simplified some colliders
[/list]

[h1]Dialogue/UI/UX[/h1]

[list]
[*] Level intros can be replayed with a new button.
[*] Music changes throughout levels
[*] Adjust dialogue to match music/setting/plot
[/list]

[h1]Other[/h1]

[list]
[*] Big Head Mode and ability to disable UI awarded for beating game
[*] Added check to prevent AI getting stuck
[*] Added code to prevent AI from sliding on faces after Runner. Even if this is funny.
[/list]

notes.title: Updated beta build
notes.content:
I never did a beta devlog, so here we go.

[h1]Main changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] New levels: Warehouses and Signal Boost
[*] Performance fixes: using simpler colliders where possible
[*] Graphics: adjusting fog within levels.
[/list]

[h1]Patches[/h1]

[list]
[*] More props and scenery in levels.
[*] Planning camera rotates faster.
[*] The option to always show controls is updated correctly.
[*] Camera towers act as navigation obstacles again - no more NPCs trying to walk through them!
[*] Finally fixed an animation bug where the Runner wouldn't crouch while in a hiding spot.
[/list]

notes.title: Devlog: Feburary 2025
notes.content:
[h1]February Devlog[/h1]
So, first devlog on Steam. I don't have a fixed timeline for these, but I think it's about time I reported [i]some [/i]progress. I've updated the demo to include some of the new features as well, so go ahead and give it a try!

Here's a quick video summary:

[previewyoutube=KjqiVHN454Q;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Next release[/h2]
The next release will be around the end of March/start of April, which is going to be when I enter Steam Early Access. 

[h2]UI/UX improvements[/h2]
Some feedback from a former colleague and from demoing at the Galway Game Devs meetup this month was to improve cutscenes and add some colour-coding for the planning stage.

Cutscenes will not advance unless you, the player, manually clicks a button. This should allow you to read at your leisure. I've also adjusted the size and position of the in-mission dialogue.

Planning now uses colour-coded arrows and buttons to highlight particular things. I've tried to make that usable for anyone with colour-blindness, using a 3rd-party filter to simulate it in Godot. The auto-generated thumbnail for the video version actually shows that filter in effect.

[h2]New levels[/h2]
I don't show this in the video, but there will be two new levels. The first involves your Runner friend getting onto a rooftop to scout out an old police station, and the second will involve her sneaking out of said police station. As usual, you'll provide overwatch/sniper cover.

[h2]Potential achievements/rewards[/h2]
I'm considering adding achievements. Obviously, there will be ones for completing the game, but I'm also thinking of adding ones for:

[list]
[*] Destroying the target before the Runner gets there.
[*] Completing a level without being detected.
[*] Falling in the water.
[*] Completing the game with Big Head Mode enabled.
[/list]

Did I just include that last one? Errr...yes. I'm considering making that a reward for beating the game, purely because I think it's [i]funny[/i]!

I'm going to shut up now. See you in the next one, and feel free to try out the demo!
-Aceade
